name: universal-media-downloader
description: Universal Media Downloader - Descargador profesional multimedia para Windows y Web

scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild server/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server/app.cjs
scripts.dist: node scripts/verify-binaries.js && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:electron: node scripts/verify-binaries.js && npm run build && electron-builder --win
